name: dumbbell one arm reverse fly (with support) v. 2
description: A supported one-arm reverse fly that isolates the rear delts. Bracing with your other hand helps you keep a steady torso.
instructions: Hinge forward and brace your free hand on a bench or support.
Hold a light dumbbell hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight elbow bend.
Lift until your arm is about parallel to the floor.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
